description: Add a Docker container, systemd unit, or PM2 app to the watch list. This writes the list and nothing begins watching it — a supervisor has to be installed separately, which only the operator can do. Adding a target twice is reported as added=false rather than an error

container.description: Container, unit, or app name to watch

kind.description: What it is: docker, systemd, or pm2 (default docker)

server.description: Remote server name from config (optional, runs locally if omitted)

unit.description: Actual unit or app name when it differs from the name above (optional)

name: watch_add
